published_title: Building Instructions For The Second Death Star
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''mist _hunter''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.
description: This deck builds that famous giant disco ball then moves it around the galaxy to cause major force loss. Whenever a pitiful alliance ship challenges this mighty height of engineering, a swarm of ships come out and blast it to oblivion.
cards: posted: Death Star II Coolant Shaft
posted: Death Star II Docking Bay
posted: Death Star II Reactor Core
posted: Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand
posted: Death Star Superlaser Mark II
posted: They're Coming In Too Fast
notes: Posted 28 May 2001, before Coruscant; no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as described in the strategy: Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost, Endor, Endor: Bunker, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) and Operational As Planned, which takes Death Star II, Moff Jerjerrod and Desperate Counter into hand; these count toward the 60. Desperate Counter goes to hand, not the table, so no starting Effect is set.

The list posts SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons x1, but the post's 'DECK EDIT' says it should be x4 and the WEAPONS header says 6; the edit is applied (4 copies), bringing the total to 60. As listed without the edit it adds to 57.

Posted 'Endor', 'Endor Bunker', 'Endor Landing Platform (Docking Bay)', 'Death Star II', 'Kashyyyk' and 'Sullust' dested the Dark pages; 'Death Star II Capacitators' dested Death Star II: Capacitors; 'Death Star Superlaser Mark II' dested Superlaser Mark II; 'Dreadnought-Class Heavy Cruiser' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Inconsequintial Losses' dested Inconsequential Losses; 'Endor Operaitions/ Imperial Outpost' dested Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost; 'That Things Operational' dested That Thing's Operational; 'Evader/ Monnok' dested Evader & Monnok; 'Twi-lek Advisor' dested Twi'lek Advisor.
Secret Plans and No Escape are 2001 Effects (not Reflections III Defensive Shields), counted in the 60.
